header: The small badges after a person's name on a card (step 47b): EXE (an executive, as before) and PhD (a non-medical employee on the manual list of employees/honorific.ts). A doctor has no PhD badge: the "Dr." before the name and the designation under it already say it. I made PhD a badge and not text added to the name, so the name stays clean for Copy, the table, the CSV and the sort order.

symbols.name: PersonBadges
symbols.sig: export function PersonBadges({ isExecutive, phd, discipline }: { isExecutive?: boolean; phd?: boolean; discipline?: string | null })

params.name: { isExecutive, phd, discipline }
params.type: { isExecutive?: boolean; phd?: boolean; discipline?: string | null }

behaviours: an executive: the EXE badge, exactly as before, and no PhD
an executive with a PhD: EXE first, then PhD
a non-executive with a PhD: only PhD
the PhD badge says in words what it is
it is a different colour from EXE and neither red nor green
a doctor (no phd flag, only the Dr. title on the name) gets no PhD badge
a missing flag is the same as false
a doctor with a discipline: EXE first, then the discipline chip, then nothing else
the chip says in words what it is, and has its own colour (not EXE's amber, not PhD's sky)
the order is EXE, discipline, PhD
no discipline (unknown, empty, null): no chip, and the EXE badge is exactly as before
a non-executive doctor: just the chip
a long discipline is shown whole
